messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High 5xx rate and latency on embeddings-service (us-west-2). 5m error rate > 12%, traffic spike from route /v1/embeddings:hot. Paging oncall.
oncall-anna: Got it, I'm oncall. Investigating. What's impacted?
sre-ben: I'm pulling the autoscaler and recent deploys now. No deploys in last 2 hours. Seeing a sudden QPS surge from a small number of IP ranges and a few API keys.
eng-ryan: Looks like one customer job is sending many large-batch embedding requests with seq_len 4096. KV cache pressure + OOM spikes on a subset of pods.
oncall-anna: Risk: embeddings saturating GPU memory, causing evictions that ripple into chat pods due to shared node pools. Immediate mitigation options: 1) rate-limit per-endpoint QPS for embeddings route 2) carve capacity: move some reserved capacity to hosted chat 3) disable rerank on hot routes to free CPU. Thoughts?
sre-ben: I'll attempt a quick per-endpoint quota tweak first. Plan: reduce embeddings route QPS for free/org tier by 60% and cap max batch size to 512 for 5m. Command I will run: `adminctl quota update --route /v1/embeddings --org-tier free --qps 40 --max-batch 512 --reason "live mitigation - spike"`
support-maya: Support already seeing error reports from several customers. Notifying top 5 impacted affected accounts and putting a banner in dashboard.
oncall-anna: @ben please execute and confirm. Also @ryan prepare fallback model variant that uses lower memory quantization if we need to route traffic.
sre-ben: Executing now. `> adminctl quota update ...` -> API returned 200. Applying to edge config.
sre-ben: Changes propagated to gateways. Monitoring. Initial telemetry: embeddings QPS dropped 58% within 30s, 5xx rate dropping but still elevated (6%). Latency improving.
eng-ryan: I'm enabling a temporary routing rule to send non-critical embedding requests to a cheaper, lower-memory model: `routingctl add-rule --match route:/v1/embeddings --if header:x-priority!=high --dest model:embed-lite-v2`
oncall-anna: Good. Also disable rerank on specific heavy customer routes to cut CPU: `feature-flag disable rerank --route /v1/search/rerank --scope customer:acct-54321` (we should only target blatantly noisy customers).
support-maya: Customer acct-54321 confirmed they have a background job; they've paused it on request. Thanks.
pm-liz: Need communications plan: are we safe to say degraded for embeddings only, partial impact, no data loss?
oncall-anna: Yes, degraded quality/availability for embeddings for some users. No data loss. We're performing selective throttles and routing. Please send a short status to impacted customers: "We detected high embedding request volume and applied temporary limits; service is recovering."
sre-ben: 5xx rate back to baseline ~1.2% after 6 minutes. Memory pressure normalized on affected nodes. Rolling revert plan: keep quotas for next 30m, then gradually relax if stable.
eng-ryan: Rolling back rerank disable for acct-54321 after they confirmed pause. Will keep embed-lite routing for low-priority traffic for 15m.
oncall-anna: Thanks team. Action items: 1) ben: monitor for 1hr, prepare full rollback commands 2) ryan: create a permanent rule suggestion for large-batch limits and model-variant fallback 3) maya: follow-up with impacted customers and log timelines.
sre-ben: Ack. Creating an incident ticket and assigning a postmortem owner.
oncall-anna: Reassigning to pm-liz for postmortem and stakeholder comms.
pm-liz: On it. Will draft postmortem and recommend per-endpoint soft-limits + alerting on long-running batch jobs.
sre-ben: Final note: no downstream chat outages observed after carve; mitigation worked as intended. Closing the page in 30m if stable. :white_check_mark:
